originalPassage: A god called Moinee was defeated by a rival god called Dromerdeener in a terrible battle up in the stars. Moinee fell out of the stars down to Tasmania to die. Before he died, he wanted to give a last blessing to his final resting place, so he decided to create humans. But he was in such a hurry, knowing he was dying, that he forgot to give them knees; and he absent-mindedly gave them big tails like kangaroos, which meant they couldn't sit down. Then he died. The people hated having kangaroo tails and no knees, and they cried out to the heavens for help. Dromerdeener heard their cry and came down to Tasmania to see what the matter was. He took pity on the people, gave them bendable knees and cut off their inconvenient kangaroo tails so they could all sit down at last. Then they lived happily ever after.

question.direction: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

markedExpressions.label: (A)
markedExpressions.surroundingText: Moinee fell out of the stars down to Tasmania to die.

markedExpressions.label: (B)
markedExpressions.surroundingText: But he was in such a hurry, knowing he was dying, that he forgot to give them knees;

markedExpressions.surroundingText: gave them big tails like kangaroos, which meant they couldn't sit down. Then he died.

markedExpressions.surroundingText: He took pity on the people, gave them bendable knees and cutting off their inconvenient kangaroo tails so they could all sit down at last.

wrongOptionExplanations.(A): 문장의 주어 Moinee에 이어지는 본동사 자리이므로 과거형 동사 fell은 적절합니다.
wrongOptionExplanations.(B): 주어인 he가 죽어가고 있다는 사실을 능동적으로 인지하고 있는 상태를 나타내므로 현재분사 knowing은 적절합니다.
wrongOptionExplanations.(C): 앞 문장 전체를 선행사로 받아 부연 설명을 이어가는 관계대명사의 계속적 용법으로 which는 적절합니다.
wrongOptionExplanations.(E): 동사 lived를 수식하며 '행복하게 살았다'라는 의미를 완성하는 부사 자리이므로 happily는 적절합니다.

question.explanation: 문장의 주어인 He에 연결되는 세 가지 동작이 and를 통해 병렬 구조를 이루고 있습니다. took(불쌍히 여겼고), gave(무릎을 주었으며)와 함께 문맥상 '꼬리를 잘랐다'라는 동작이 대등하게 이어져야 하므로, 준동사인 cutting을 앞선 과거동사들과 시제를 일치시킨 과거동사 cut으로 고쳐야 합니다. 'cutting off'를 분사구문으로 오해할 수 있으나, 등위접속사 and가 이미 존재하므로 동사가 나열되는 구조로 파악하는 것이 타당합니다.
keyPoints: (D) 병렬 구조 — 등위접속사 and로 연결되는 동사의 형태 일치 여부 확인
(B) 분사의 능동과 수동 — 생략된 주어와의 능동적 의미 강도를 통한 현재분사 선택
(C) 관계대명사 — 계속적 용법의 which가 이끄는 절의 완전성 및 기능 판단
